tacho_extract_fallback.note: EXTRACT fault routing is tested in SHADOW, but fallback percentages require real workshop airflow/pressure validation.

tacho_both_fallback.note: BOTH fault routing is tested in SHADOW, but the emergency action requires real workshop safety validation.
